scenes.say: Just ate? Don't sit down yet. Do this instead.
scenes.headline: DON'T SIT DOWN YET

scenes.say: A short, easy walk after meals can help lower your blood sugar spike.
scenes.headline: WALK AFTER MEALS

scenes.say: Even two to five minutes of light walking helps.
scenes.headline: EVEN 2-5 MINUTES

scenes.say: So skip the couch. Take a quick stroll.
scenes.headline: COUCH ➜ STROLL
